about.text: Sweet whey with most of its mineral salts removed, then evaporated and spray-dried. Heavily demineralised grades (about 90 %) are a main ingredient of infant formula, because they give whey protein and lactose without the mineral load of whey or milk.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 18 Milk and whey fractionation

facts.v: 25-30 % of the ash removed (nanofiltration: about 30 % at 22 % dry matter, 4x concentration, 21 °C, 2.5 MPa; chloride falls 67 %, sodium 33 %, potassium 31 %, calcium only 3 %)
Best below 70 %; batch of 2-3 h for 90 % at 10-15 °C; whey first concentrated to 20-30 % dry matter
Cation and anion resin; a cycle of about 6 h, 4 h of it regenerating the resin
Going from 50 % to 90 % demineralised makes the cost per kg of solids about four times higher (Tetra Pak)
